title: Ladders.
officialText:
There shall be a ladder or steps with handrails at the deep end and at the shallow end of every swimming
pool. Ladders and steps shall have no-slip treads. All ladders shall be rigidly installed and shall be constructed of corrosion-
resistant materials.
